fold_selection.rule: Pilot seeds only (base 8,000,000), 300 patients per grid point, regular_N arm only, ou_ss null, index analysis. Eligible: tipping <= 5%. Among eligible points choose the one whose regular_N variance detection is closest to 50% and inside [35%, 65%]; ties -> smaller sigma_f, then larger r_end. The informative arm is never computed in the pilot. If no point is eligible, fold_v2 is not run and the fold model is reported as uninformative.

deviations.deviation: frozen E3 lists ct|W30 for 2,000 patients (about 69 million window fits). Reduced to patients 0-999; recorded as a deviation. At n = 1,000 the TOST passes for observed rates of 3.4-6.1% (probability of passing 0.94 if the true rate is 5%). n = 1,000 is the target. If the timing pilot projects more than 12 hours, a reduction to n = 500 is allowed only with recorded approval (deviations.json entry before the run). An n = 500 result is STRICTLY DESCRIPTIVE: it cannot establish CALIBRATED status, so ct|W30 cannot be classified as GENUINE_RECOVERY or support any claim of controlled false-alarm rates (TOST at n = 500 passes only for 3.8-5.4%, probability 0.62 at a true 5%).
